evidence_levels.environment_reproduction: Observed through the pinned complete environment and supported configuration.
evidence_levels.training_effect: Observed during training with independent outcome measurements.

confirmed_component_findings.requirement: DOCX memo must contain a readable metric table; prompt specifies no thousands-separator convention.
confirmed_component_findings.observation: Identical numeric figures in two positive table cells pass with commas and fail without commas. All other document text including negative amount is fixed.
confirmed_component_findings.mechanism: The published _money helper searches for comma-formatted substrings instead of comparing numeric values.
confirmed_component_findings.limit: Component check on paired synthetic DOCX tables; neither full submission, total reward nor training effect was measured.
